title: Feed counters get a quieter update
summary:
A quieter feed display and a community browser script added to the project list.

The feed now displays generation rates and increments image and text counters at five times their previous values. The count badge also no longer blinks or glows. Load-bar thresholds still use the original rate.

Pollinations.ai Enhancer was added to the Tools & Interfaces list. The script offers readability improvements, download options, and access to generation metadata; this change lists the tool rather than changing pollinations.ai pages.
